method.title: How Libero Mail connects: IMAP and your Libero password
method.body: Libero serves IMAP at imapmail.libero.it on port 993 and SMTP at smtp.libero.it on port 465, both with SSL/TLS and authentication required on SMTP. Libero's help is specific about the username: always the full address with its domain, whether that is @libero.it, @iol.it, @blu.it or @inwind.it, and the password of your Libero Mail account. Virgilio Mail, run by the same company, publishes its own names, in.virgilio.it on 993 and out.virgilio.it on 465, with the same rules. There is no IMAP switch to find in the webmail and no plan condition: IMAP is documented for every mailbox. What changes the password is Password Sicura, Libero's two-step login. Once it is on, Libero states that the normal password keeps working in the browser only, and mail programs need a Password specifica per applicazioni generated from the account area.

setup.p: Sign up at mcpemails.com. The free plan connects one inbox, forever, and does not ask for a card.

setup.h: Check whether Password Sicura is on
setup.p: Sign in to Libero Mail in a browser and click the Account icon at the top right. If you see Attiva Password Sicura, it is off and your ordinary Libero password is the one to use. If it is already on, open the Sicurezza area and look for Password per App. Virgilio shows the same screens under Impostazioni Password Sicura at account.virgilio.it.

setup.h: With Password Sicura on, generate an app password
setup.p: Under Password per App, create a new password and name it MCPEmails. Libero generates a 16-character string, shown once. It is valid for mail programs only; your normal password still signs you in to the webmail. Make one per program you connect.

setup.h: Paste the address and password into MCPEmails
setup.p: Choose IMAP / SMTP, enter the full address with its domain, and paste whichever password applies. The hosts and ports are prefilled from the verified values on this page. Then drop https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT, authorize, and your agent has the inbox.

gotchas.h: Password Sicura silently retires your password for mail programs
gotchas.p: Libero's own troubleshooting article puts it first: if you cannot sign in from a mail program and Password Sicura is on, check that you are entering the Password specifica per app rather than the account password. The failure looks like a typo, because the server answers with a plain refusal. The fix is the Password per App section of the account area, and the 16-character value it generates. Turning Password Sicura off again puts the account password back in charge.

gotchas.h: Four months without a login and the mailbox is switched off
gotchas.p: Libero deactivates a free mailbox that has not been signed in to for more than four months (120 days), and a deactivated mailbox neither receives nor sends. Signing in at login.libero.it within nine months reactivates it at no cost; after nine months (270 days) the mailbox and its contents are deleted. An agent reading over IMAP does count as use, but if you are reviving an old address, sign in to the webmail first and check it is active before connecting it.

gotchas.h: Virgilio is the same platform with different host names
gotchas.p: A Virgilio address will not sign in on the Libero hosts, and the reverse, even though both answer with the same Dovecot banner and send through the same iol.local cluster. Virgilio documents in.virgilio.it for IMAP and out.virgilio.it for SMTP, and its own Password Sicura pages mirror Libero's. MCPEmails prefills the right pair from the address you type.

Libero and Virgilio cap an outgoing message at 25 MB; above that, the webmail offers its DriveMail link instead. The SMTP server advertises 50 MB, but the mailbox rule is the one that applies to a client, so a large attachment is refused at send time rather than trimmed. Corporate proxies, Libero notes, can also block POP and IMAP connections to outside mailboxes, which is not a problem for a hosted server but explains failures from an office network.

limits: Libero does not advertise SPECIAL-USE, so folders are matched by name rather than by role. On an Italian mailbox that usually means Posta in arrivo, Inviata, Bozze and Cestino. If you have renamed a folder, name it when you ask for a move.
A standard Libero mailbox cannot forward all mail to an outside address; that is a Mail Plus feature. It does not affect an IMAP connection, which reads the mailbox in place.

faq.q: Does Claude work with Libero Mail?
faq.a: Not directly. Claude has no built-in Libero connector and cannot open an IMAP connection by itself. Connecting an MCP server such as MCPEmails to your libero.it, iol.it, blu.it, inwind.it or virgilio.it mailbox gives Claude read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize access to it, and the same connection works in Cursor and other MCP clients.

faq.q: What are the Libero Mail IMAP and SMTP settings?
faq.a: IMAP is imapmail.libero.it on port 993 with SSL/TLS. SMTP is smtp.libero.it on port 465, also SSL/TLS, with authentication required. The username is your full address including the domain. Virgilio Mail uses in.virgilio.it on 993 and out.virgilio.it on 465. All four hosts were confirmed from a live TLS connection.

faq.q: Why is my Libero password rejected in a mail client?
faq.a: Almost always because Password Sicura is on. Libero then accepts the account password in the browser only, and mail programs need a Password specifica per applicazioni generated under Password per App in the account area. The other cause is a mailbox deactivated after four months without a login, which you reactivate by signing in to the webmail.

faq.q: Do I need Libero Mail Plus for IMAP?
faq.a: No. Libero's configuration guide lists IMAP without any plan condition, and its Mail Plus pages describe the paid benefits as no advertising, external forwarding, aliases, more space and exemption from the inactivity rule. IMAP is not among them.

faq.q: Does this work for Virgilio Mail too?
faq.a: Yes. Virgilio is run by the same company and documents the same setup with its own hosts, in.virgilio.it and out.virgilio.it, and its own Password Sicura with a 16-character app password. Enter the address with the virgilio.it domain and MCPEmails prefills the Virgilio hosts.

faq.q: Is my Libero mail stored on your servers?
faq.a: No. Messages are fetched live from Libero over IMAP for each request and passed to your AI client. Credentials are encrypted at rest and message bodies are not retained.
